name: field-guide
description: Optional local guidance that learns durable preferences and corrections without loading its complete store into context.

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve and maintain bounded local guidance.
interface.longDescription: Field Guide stores durable preferences, corrections, and recurring lessons locally. It retrieves only relevant guidance, keeps live code and current instructions authoritative, and provides explicit audit and maintenance paths.
defaultPrompt: Use $field-guide:field-guide to retrieve or manage durable local guidance.
Use $field-guide:field-guide audit to inspect stored guidance without changing it.
